contentPattern.structure: large background image + heading + short description (no CTA)
contentPattern.note: Full-width background photograph with an overlapping white content panel (heading + one-line description) at the lower-left. Introductory banner below the page title; distinct from hero-promo which is dark and carries a CTA.

suitableFor: light introductory hero banners at the top of a landing/listing page
full-width image banners with a heading + short description and NO call-to-action
page-intro heroes where the text sits in an overlapping light panel over the photo
notSuitableFor: dark promotional banners with a CTA button (use hero-promo)
repeating image + title + description grids (use cards-teaser)

relatedBlocks.hero-promo: Dark mid-page promotional hero using the cmp-teaser--imagebottom layout with a 'See Trip' CTA. Same hero base block but different color scheme (dark vs light), purpose (promo vs intro), and it has a CTA whereas hero-intro does not. Similarity ~38% (below the 80% reuse threshold), so hero-intro is a separate variant.
relatedBlocks.carousel-hero: Rotating multi-slide top hero (homepage). Not reusable here - this is a single static intro banner.

usage.note: New light intro-hero variant of the hero block. Models the 'Experience the world with us' banner below the Adventures page title (full-width image + heading + one-line description, no CTA).
